name: vachan
description: Vachan — AI-powered Indian language learning platform

scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
